ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name CareCorner (CareCorner Health Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.carecorner.example
Location Hyderabad, Telangana
Incorporated August 2025
One-line description Neighbourhood primary-care clinics with in-house diagnostics for Tier-2
cities.
Sector (as selected) Other (Healthcare)
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 14, including 3 doctors
Founders
Founder 1 Dr. Lakshmi Reddy, CEO. MBBS, 8 years in family medicine.
linkedin.com/in/lakshmi-reddy-example
Founder 2 Vikram Rao, COO. 6 years in operations at a hospital chain.
linkedin.com/in/vikram-rao-example
Time commitment Both full-time since August 2025.
Prior startup experience None.
Equity split Founders 75%, angels 25%.
Product and traction
What have you built? Three 1,200 sq ft neighbourhood clinics in Hyderabad suburbs, each
with a family doctor, in-house diagnostics and a pharmacy.
Revenue INR 9.8 L across the three clinics in October 2026. The first clinic
reached monthly breakeven in month 8.
Patient acquisition About INR 210 per new patient. Local doctor referrals 45%, WhatsApp
and Google listings 35%, health camps 20%.
Capex INR 28 L per clinic, funded by angels and a INR 40 L bank loan.
Key risks Capital intensity, doctor retention, and slower ramp in new locations.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 3 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 18 Cr post-money

Existing investors Angels INR 60 L, bank loan INR 40 L.
Use of funds Five new clinics, working capital, team and systems.
Other investors in
conversation
Two healthcare-focused funds.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We can share clinic-level P&Ls.
